name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.103.0 — a mixed pin/promise AC bullet no longer ships silently sanctioned: `lib/spec-sections.js` exports `pinShape(raw)` (`promise` | `pin` | `mixed`, by `SHALL CONTINUE TO` vs bare `SHALL` count) and `normalizeForPinCheck(raw)`, lifted byte-for-byte from `red-check.js`'s own local copy so `red-check.js`, `ac-drift.js`, and the new `ac-matrix.js --lint` mode share one predicate. `red-check.js` refuses a mixed carried AC with a single hard `mixed-pin` finding (the split-the-bullet remedy named, no `unsanctioned-green` attached, and the run exits 1) instead of sanctioning the file green; `ac-matrix.js --lint` runs the AC-line lint alone at `/spec:plan` lock (`malformed-ac`, `invalid-pre-green`, `mixed-pin` as hard findings, zero findings to lock), while the full review-mode matrix prints a mixed bullet as a warning only, never a finding, so `/spec:replay` against older, pre-guard specs stays a fair measurement. `spec-review-driver.js`'s CLOSE step gains one advisory line printing the repo's current AC-pin drift count (`ac-drift.js --json`) after the hygiene listing — informational only, it never touches the verdict, the ledger row, or mark acceptance. 7.102.0 — the review fix-cap survives a cold restart — spec-review-driver counts this spec's uncleared `escalated:true` ledger rows as spent iterations, so deleting the sidecar no longer resets the loop (dispositions warns before workers are dispatched into a spent cap); design Step 6 gains the blocking AC ↔ design-landed reconcile (`design-ac-reconcile.js`: an AC naming a landed component must be tagged `[pre-green: design-landed]` or cited in Decisions before `designed:` stamps); exit 124 from the gate or a red-check run auto-records a `test-watchdog-trip` incident on the build row. 7.101.0 — build-time incidents count toward materiality (core § Incident Policy): `spec-build-driver --mark incident --class <id> [--exit <n>]` records an entry on the `stage:"build"` row (`incidents: [{ts, class, exit}]`, always present, `[]` when none) at any live step without moving the state; fleet-reader `--json` joins those entries into `escapes.byClass`/`recurrentUnguarded`/`registry` alongside escape rows and reports `escapes.incidents`, so a class that only ever costs build time can reach the third recurrence — previously it scored 0 forever (host spec 20260905/07 D16). `escapes.total` stays escape rows only. No red-check refusal is added: no class has reached three.
